name: cfcmt-bus-zero-hold-eval-v1

evaluation.test_separation: New fixed demand/SUMO seed realizations, disjoint from fit/stop/calibrate; same pinned timetable and generated route corridors.
evaluation.comparison: Three training seeds, three paired generated demand days; retain every branch/day/seed and compare all-seed means.
evaluation.completion: Report completion rate and departed/completed counts alongside cost.
evaluation.interpretation: Bounded pilot on one target city; no population-level CI or city removal.

proposal: Always zero seconds before the original guard; encode with hold_seconds_to_policy_action_v7(0.0), not action0
artifacts: Three independent case jobs, no training seed or checkpoint; original assets and CFCMT frozen runtime, no mutable Thesis imports/writes
metrics: Cost, waiting/in-vehicle time, completion, proposed holding, guarded holding requests, and guard increases/decreases; environment execution layer retained
interpretation: Three previously analyzed generated demand/SUMO cases in one corridor city. Zero autonomous proposals retain all original execution constraints and may produce positive guarded holding. Model seeds reuse the corresponding zero case;21paired policy comparisons are not21independent zero runs.
next_decision: Compare rule and adaptation-stage policies against zero autonomous holding to diagnose their net control benefit before additional training. This is not an optimal-policy lower bound or a proof that no better holding policy exists.
data_boundary: No training, target/source data reads, world-model load, checkpoint load, or simulator trajectory export; retrieve only small JSON summaries
